intro: A Bubble Fighter community server built with C# and .NET 10. Build your own server and bring your ideas to life with plugins.
descriptions: Prepare your environment, build the project, and start a local server.
Compose services with clear configuration and choose how your server runs.
Add your own functionality with .NET plugins or a language SDK.

wizard.title: Prepare your install prompt
wizard.lead: Answer a few questions and we will write a prompt that fits your setup.
wizard.whereQ: Where do you want to deploy the server?
wizard.serverDesc: A cloud or dedicated machine that stays online for other players.
wizard.pcDesc: This computer, for yourself or your local network.
wizard.launcherTitle: You may not need a server at all
wizard.launcherBody: To play on your own PC, use Fantasy Tale Launcher. It creates rooms and starts single play directly, with no server to install or maintain.
wizard.osServerQ: Which operating system does your server run?
wizard.osPcQ: Which operating system does your PC run?
wizard.dbQ: Would you like to install a database?
wizard.passwordGenerate: Leave empty and the AI generates one
wizard.passwordAsk: Leave empty and the AI asks you
wizard.passwordNote: The AI service you paste the prompt into can read the password, so use one made only for this database.
wizard.sqliteHint: SQLite keeps all data in a single file, which suits a small server. Choose it on the setup page.
wizard.agentOnServerDesc: {agent} is installed on the server itself.
wizard.agentOnPcDesc: {agent} connects to the server over SSH.
wizard.sshNote: Sign-in uses your SSH key. Leave these empty and the AI will ask you.
wizard.opensshTitle: Install OpenSSH Server on the Windows server first
wizard.opensshBody: Windows does not accept SSH connections by default, so {agent} cannot reach the server until OpenSSH Server is installed. Sign in to the server (for example with Remote Desktop) and run these lines once in PowerShell as administrator, or download and run the installer below.
wizard.privacyNote: We never save or upload your username and password. They stay on this page and only go into the prompt you copy; the preview shows them as ********.
wizard.nativeDesc: Installed directly and run as a system service.
wizard.dockerDesc: Runs in containers with Docker Compose.
wizard.dockerQ: Is Docker already installed on the server?
wizard.dockerDbNote: The installer runs the database in a container and creates the user bff with a random password on the server. Nothing to fill in here; the AI tells you where to find it.
wizard.pcSqliteHint: On your own PC, SQLite is recommended: it needs no database server to install or keep running.
